title: PaintingsGUI
description: PaintingsGUI adds a gui that allows you to choose whichever painting you desire without having to cycle through them!
body:
## About
This mod changes how paintings work; instead of having to place and break them repeatedly to get the painting you desire, a nice little GUI pops up that lets you decide which painting you want that fits the provided area.

This GUI makes it **easier** to place your favorite Minecraft paintings without any trouble!



### Dependencies:
Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
